leads.claim: IBM research chemist Marcel Vogel examined a metal specimen allegedly obtained from aliens by Billy Meier.
leads.why: The text describes a specific individual analyzing a physical metal specimen attributed to an extraterrestrial source, though the origin remains unverified.
leads.quote: Marcel Vogel, a 27-year veteran of IBM and holder of numerous patents, examined a metal specimen Meier allegedly got from the aliens.

doc_verdict: The document contains no evidence of government or contractor possession of UAP material, mentioning only a private analysis of a specimen by an IBM chemist and various anecdotal claims regarding extraterrestrial encounters.
